definition: The chosen carrier represents objects that exist at the standpoint: objects, not a mere roster of possible candidates or an added null object. ObjectPopulation B is Nonempty B. This model has no Ontic/world/concreteness field, so a Lean carrier's population alone supplies no independent actuality or concrete-existence theorem.
note: Rutten p124 permits abstract or concrete objects and p132 discusses restricting the domain to concreta. Those are distinct applications. The finite two-object interpretation is a logical witness only.
